root_idea.summary: An irregular hamzated lexical family centered on the human individual and its feminine counterpart, with related vocabulary for human excellence, bodily digestion, and food that agrees with one's constitution.
root_idea.development: The person terms are treated as a set of non-productive inherited forms rather than a single regular pattern. From the person notion, مُرُوءَة denotes perfected manliness, while مَرِيء and related forms concern the throat-adjacent stomach and the agreeableness of food.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized masculine-person citation form مَرْء.
Displayed as the distinct Quranic adjective مَرِيء.
An inflected Quranic variant in the construction امْرَأَ سُوء, covered by the male-person noun.
Displayed under the normalized feminine citation form امْرَأَة.
Case-form variant امْرِئِ of the masculine-person noun.
The Quranic form امْرُؤٌ is an inherited citation-form variant of the masculine-person noun.

senses.definition: An individual person; in gendered or contextual usage, a man.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun appears in inherited forms including مَرْء، امْرُؤ، امْرِئ، and امْرَأ. In the construction امْرَأَ سُوء, the person is characterized by the following qualification; the qualification is not part of the headword's meaning.

senses.definition: A woman; in relation to a husband, a wife.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form covers singular, dual, case, and possessive forms. The relational sense 'wife' is contextual usage of the noun, not a separate lexical headword.

senses.definition: Agreeable, wholesome, and easy to consume or digest.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of food or what is consumed, especially in the Quranic expression هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fullness or perfection of the person, especially perfected manliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun describing human completeness rather than the ordinary noun for a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper part of the stomach and the adjacent rumen attached to the throat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, distinct from the Quranic adjectival use meaning agreeable or wholesome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The digestibility or agreeableness of food—its being well received by the natural constitution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun for the quality of being مَرِيئًا or easy to digest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of food, to be agreeable to a person, suit the constitution, or be well tolerated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The food may be construed as agreeing with or pleasing a person, as in the construction مَرَأَنِي الطَّعَامُ / أَمْرَأَنِي.

cautions: No Lane primary source units were supplied in this packet; the broader classical branches therefore rely on the supplied Maqayis and Mufradat evidence.
The six QAC groups include inherited spelling and case variants of the masculine-person noun; they are consolidated under one public headword rather than treated as separate meanings.
مَرِيء has two distinct attested branches: the Quranic adjective meaning agreeable or wholesome to consume and the classical anatomical noun.
